hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path') or d.get('path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.java$' || exit 0; grep -q 'System\.out\.println' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo "[HOOK] System.out.println 금지: $FILE (@Slf4j 사용)"; grep -q 'FetchType\.EAGER' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo "[HOOK] FetchType.EAGER 금지: $FILE (LAZY + fetch join)"; grep -q '@Autowired' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo "[HOOK] @Autowired 금지: $FILE (@RequiredArgsConstructor 사용)"; grep -qE 'private (Long|long) ' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo "[HOOK] Long 타입 필드 감지: $FILE (PK는 UUID 사용)"; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'Entity\.java$' && grep -q '@Builder' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo "[HOOK] Entity @Builder 금지: $FILE (정적 팩토리 메서드 사용)"; echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'Controller\.java$' && grep -q 'MoNew-Request-User-ID' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo "[HOOK] 헤더 오타 감지: MoNew → Monew 확인 $FILE"; exit 0

echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'jacocoTestReport|gradlew test' || exit 0; REPORT='build/reports/jacoco/test/jacocoTestReport.xml'; [ ! -f "$REPORT" ] && exit 0; MISSED=$(grep -o 'missed="[0-9]*"' "$REPORT" | awk -F'"' '{s+=$2} END{print s}'); COVERED=$(grep -o 'covered="[0-9]*"' "$REPORT" | awk -F'"' '{s+=$2} END{print s}'); TOTAL=$((MISSED+COVERED)); [ "$TOTAL" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; PCT=$((COVERED*100/TOTAL)); [ "$PCT" -lt 80 ] && echo "[HOOK] 커버리지 ${PCT}% — 80% 미달"; exit 0
